scientific_integrity: Proof given for all n>=3 using classical transfer-current theorem; new wheel-specific spectral diagonalization and crossover have been separately recomputed using exact rational finite examples and rational interval bounds. No independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight simple wheels and centered one-edge indicator functions only.
General transfer-current determinant and wheel Green kernel are prior work.
Specialized older wheel covariance or sampling literature may contain an equivalent spectral statement.
title: Exact covariance spectrum and a sharp extremal-mode transition for wheel spanning-tree sampling
